Tab PCM 650 mg po \/TID\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E6. Monitor vitals and inform sos\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E7. Inj SUCROSE 200Mg in 100 ml NS IV on alternate day\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E8. Inj VITLOFOL 1000mcg IM OD\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E9. Strict I\/0 Charting\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E"},"link":[{"rel":"replies","type":"application/atom+xml","href":"https:\/\/lekhanakeetha64.blogspot.com\/feeds\/3188947411072030385\/comments\/default","title":"Post EXAMS\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENAME : LEKHANA\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EROLL NO: 64\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EDATE: 8 DECEMBER,2023\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EBlog link:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E1) AUTOIMMUNE HEPATITIS:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E-Autoimmune hepatitis is when the body’s infection-fighting system (immune system) attacks your liver cells.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E-It is a long-term chronic liver disease that causes inflammation and liver damage.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EExperts don’t know what causes it, but it is more likely to appear in people living with other autoimmune conditions. Certain medications can also trigger autoimmune hepatitis.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E-It affects more women than men.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E-It can lead to scarring of the liver (cirrhosis) and liver failure\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E2)CIRRHOGENIC DOSE OF ALCOHOL:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E- Time to develop Alcoholic liver disease is equal to amount of alcohol consumed\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E-Men:60-80gm \/day for 10years\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E-Women:20-40gm \/day for 10 years\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E- Alcoholic Cirrhosis,develops only in 10-20% of those who are chronically heavy drinkers.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E3) VIRAL HEPATITIS LEADING TO LIVER CIRRHOSIS:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E- Heaptitis A has low chances of leading to long term complications like Cirrhosis,because the infection lasts for a short period\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E-HBV and HBC has a high risk of causing liver cirrhosis, scarring and damage to liver\u0026nbsp; in long run compared to other viruses\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E-Although acute HBV\/HDV coinfections can resolve, HDV superinfection can lead to rapid progression of the already present HBV infection, resulting in liver cirrhosis and liver failure. These outcomes occur within 5–10 years in 70%–80% and within 1–2 years in 15% of people with chronic HBV\/HDV infection .\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ELEARNING POINTS :\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E1) A proper Communication is the key to the doctor and patient relationship.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E2)I have learnt about doing proper abdominal examination,importance of abdmoninal girth measurement and weight measurement\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E3)I understood the importance of taking Detailed Daily Routine and not only the regular\u0026nbsp; history part(which we regularly do)and\u0026nbsp; heamchromatosis,Viral hepatitis (Like having a Alcoholic history doesn't make sense confining only to the Alcoholic cause)\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E4) I have also learned a few New points like Cirrhogenic dose of Alcohol and how Cirrhogenic it is based on the Alcohol content in different beverages\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E5) i learnt about apraxia charting too and its year old with ascites "},"content":{"type":"html","$t":"\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EDecember 07, 2023\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThis is a case of a 39 year old bus driver who is a resident of West Bengal.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ECHIEF COMPLAINT:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAbdominal distension since 2 months.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ESwelling in the leg since 2 months.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EDecreased appetite since 2 months.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EDecreased urine output since 1 month.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS-\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient was apparently asymptomatic 2 months ago then he developed abdominal distension which was insidious in onset and gradually progressive, associated with decreased appetite. Later he developed bilateral pedal edema extending upto the knees which is of pitting type.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAfter a month his urine output got decreased still he continued his work as a bus driver.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHis relatives started noticing that his abdomen is getting distended and his appetite is decreased.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThey suggested him to see a doctor following which he took a homeopathic treatment in West Bengal But there was no improvement. He also took some ayurvedic medication but nothing seemed to work out. Then he came to our hospital with complaints of abdominal distension,pedal edema and decreased appetite.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo history of fever, breathlessness, cough\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo h\/o drowsiness, loss of consciousness, palpitations, orthopnoea,pnd ,abdominal pain, fever,nausea vomiting.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPAST HISTORY:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENot a known case of diabetes mellitus, hypertension, tuberculosis, epilepsy or any other chronic illness.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo surgical history.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPERSONAL HISTORY:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp;Married, 2 daughters\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EDiet :mixed (consumes fish and meat)\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAppetite: normal ( presently)\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ESleep: disturbed\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EBowel and bladder: normal\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAddiction : betel, bidi, alcohol\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAllergy: none\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHobbies: watching telivision\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EDaily routine:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThe patient gets up early morning at 5am. After freshing up he takes water, one cup of\u0026nbsp; lemon tea with biscuits. Then he rides his cycle almost around 5km to reach his bus stand where he is working as a bus driver. By 6:30 am he starts from Siliguri.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ESometimes he takes a 72 hrs shift (West bengal to Assam).\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAround 9am he stops his bus for having breakfast which mainly includes rice,dal, vegetables or fish.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENext stop he takes around 1pm for lunch ( rice and fish).\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHis assistant takes up the driving duty from there. At 10pm they finally go for dinner in a restaurant which mainly includes rice ,dal,vegetables or fish.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ELater he continues driving till next day morning.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EFAMILY HISTORY:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENot significant\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EClinical images:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both;
